what: A: the continent offers B's note (left by …, not kept yet) in the door; Keep it makes it an owner-signed note event

actions.eval: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ head: n.head.n, notes: Object.values(n.notes ?? {}).map(x => ({ id: x.id.slice(0, 12), n: x.n, author: x.author.slice(0, 10), name: x.body.name, via: x.body.via ?? null, text: x.body.text.slice(0, 60), coord: x.body.coord, anchors: x.body.anchors.length })) }) })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); if (!l) return 'no door layer'; const t = l.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('Continent\n'); return t.slice(i, i + 1200) })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const h = [...l.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && /Notes visitors left/.test(e.innerText)); if (h) h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return !!h })()
